hypothesis: For identical fixed-origin source memory and retrieval, ordinary readable fenced source may reduce subsequent native source reading and total normalized provider token work without reducing fixed quality. Byte shrinkage alone does not satisfy the hypothesis.

invariants.costs: Charge each condition independent origin generation, build/store/update, native/model/MCP, audit receipt/trace I/O, startup/auth/cleanup. Count each nested span once. Evaluation infrastructure separately retained; no shared setup amortization hiding costs.
invariants.leakage: Origin generation sees only canonical origin code. No future revision, history, solution, gold evaluator or other trial artifacts in model filesystem. Heldout assets not opened and model calls remain0.
invariants.lifecycle: Fresh isolated transcript/process/OpenCode DB each stage; separate persistent owned memory per condition; canonical source reset each stage; no previous patch becomes next input.
invariants.memory_generation: Same329-record immutable schema2 origin catalog for every memory condition, each independently extracted/reauthenticated/registered at origin; compare semantic bytes and IDs before models. No model-authored notes, no new writes API.
invariants.native_fallback: Identical native read/grep/shell/edit tools and same conditional memory guidance; no replacement of native grep or mandatory read suppression.
invariants.order: Freeze a deterministic five-condition stage-rotating order before calls and report incomplete position balance in this single exploratory block. No concurrent model or auxiliary CPU/timing work.
invariants.retrieval: Same existing rank, explicit query/limit API, origin-byte budget16384, ranking before availability, prefix cap2400Unicode characters and truncation contract. Do not force identical model-chosen queries after format intervention; record them as outcomes.
invariants.runtime: One frozen repaired and verified core/adapter/image/controller/harness snapshot shared by all conditions. Resolve current C3 prefix regression before admission; do not combine a core change with the display comparison.
invariants.served_tier: Record actual provider projection; requested is not served. Uniform complete tier and quiet host required for eligible wall comparisons.
invariants.static_vs_cami: Static original payloads unchecked current; CAMI uses genuine availability with no supported backfill or stale fallback. Same new display algorithm for both memory arms; all essential trust/freshness/identity/withheld/budget claims preserved.
invariants.tasks_revisions_prompts: Exactly existing two development tasks, four canonical stages, original prompts and fixed evaluators unchanged. No task or query target selection based on v6 losses.

outcomes.falsification: Any quality loss, missing telemetry or non-improvement preserves negative/inconclusive result. Smaller display bytes by themselves are not a utility win. Source overlap is not proof that a read was avoidable or memory caused an action.
outcomes.hypothesis_direction_supported_only_if: All conditions operational/quality complete with complete metrics; within EACH memory backend, fenced sequence has strictly lower total noncached normalized provider token work AND lower native read-result UTF8 bytes than compact. This is a descriptive one-block signal, not confirmed efficacy.
outcomes.quality_gate: All fixed acceptance+regression checks for every attempted trial; failures remain full outcomes. No change to tests or baseline allowance.
outcomes.secondary: Charged full wall only if quiet and provider tier comparable; full returned bytes, native tool counts, query/limits, post-memory same-file reads, stale exposure/reliance with exact public evidence and unknown after unreconstructable writes.
outcomes.token_fields: Preserve disjoint input/cache.read/cache.write/output/reasoning. Token work input+cache.write+output+reasoning, cached reads separate; do not add sessions and steps or infer price/billing.
